# Report information

## Data set information

**Sample Set:** `r params$SampleSet`

**Wetlab: ** `r params$WetLabNames`

**Data Acquisition: ** `r params$DataAcquisitionNames`

**Data Analysis: ** `r params$DataAnalysisNames`

**Date:**  `r Sys.Date()` 

**Code author:** DGZ

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
#General parameters for knitr
require("knitr")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
if (!is.null(params$ProjectDir) && nzchar(params$ProjectDir))
  knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(params$ProjectDir, mustWork = FALSE))
```


```{r initialize, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(HowMaHiCo)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)
library(plotly)
library(openxlsx)
library(DT)

# handy settings

# length window + palette of the MHC class (MHC1 8-13, MHC1_mouse 7-11,
# MHC2 12-25; anything else falls back to the ShortPeptideLength* params)
shortpep_range <- mhc_length_window(params$MHCclass,
                                    min = params$ShortPeptideLengthMin,
                                    max = params$ShortPeptideLengthMax)
shortpep_palette <- mhc_class_palette(params$MHCclass)
shortpep_colors <- setNames(shortpep_palette,
  c(paste0(shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs"), "others"))

if(params$Subset == ""){
  suffix <- params$Subset
  FolderResults <- params$FolderResults
  FolderFigures <- params$FolderFigures
}else{
  suffix <- paste0(params$Subset, "_")
  dir.create(file.path(params$FolderResults, params$Subset))
  dir.create(file.path(params$FolderFigures, params$Subset))
  FolderResults <- file.path(params$FolderResults, params$Subset)
  FolderFigures <- file.path(params$FolderFigures, params$Subset)
}

file_rda <- file.path( file.path(params$FolderData,paste0(suffix, "pep_all.rda")))

# pre-checks to avoid overwriting files
check_output_exists(params$FolderResults, overwrite =  params$ResultsOverwrite)
check_file_exists(file_rda, overwrite =  params$ResultsOverwrite)

```


# Introduction

## Context

Below are shown the UpSet plots representing the overlap between the conditions evaluated. 

## Glosary:

* Peptides (e.g. in barplots): this includes possible peptidoforms (i.e. different PTMs); although the peptides are often detected only in one peptidoform.
* Sequences (e.g. in Venn plots): this refers to the stripped peptide sequence regardless of the possible PTMs.
* All peptides = all peptides detected
* Selected peptides = `r paste0(shortpep_range[1]," to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs")`


# Input

```{r load-pep-all, echo=FALSE}
# load data from previous report
# load(file.path(params$FolderData, "pep_all_patients.rda"))
file_rda <- file.path( file.path(params$FolderData,paste0(suffix, "pep_all.rda")))


load(file_rda)

pep_all <-
  pep_all |> 
  filter(Condition != "JY_QC") |> 
  droplevels() |> 
  mutate(ProteinFirst = gsub("Cont_|cont_", "", ProteinFirst)) |> 
  mutate(Condition = fct_relabel(.f = Condition, .fun = ~ gsub("_DIA", "", .x))) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(cols = Condition , delim = "_", cols_remove = FALSE,
                       names = c("Patient", "Sample_type")) |> 
  mutate(Sample_type = factor(Sample_type, levels = c("tissue", "plasma", "PBMCs"))) |>
  mutate(Sample = sub("_1$", "", Sample) ) |> 
  relocate(Sample_type,.before = "Condition") 

write.csv(unique(pep_all[names(pep_all)[c(1:8)]]),
          file.path(params$FolderDocumentation, paste0("extended_", params$AnnotationFile)),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Always-written export: render parameters, independent of CsvSave/PlotsSave
write_input_params(params, folder = FolderResults, prefix = params$Subset)
```

```{r pep-short-data}
pep_short <- pep_all |>
    filter(Length >= shortpep_range[1], Length <= shortpep_range[2]) 

#extract simplified info
patients <- unique(pep_all$Patient)
sampletypes <- levels(pep_all$Sample_type)
samples <- levels(pep_all$Sample)
conditions <- levels(pep_all$Condition)
n_conditions <- length(conditions)
bioreplicates <- levels(pep_all$BioReplicate)
comp_condition <- condition_pairs(conditions)   # empty list when a single Condition
lengthranges <- c("all", levels(pep_all$Length_range))
# lists to drop results and plots
res <- list()
plist <- list()
```


```{r seq-unique-data}
# simplifying info
seq_all_sample <- 
  pep_all |> 
  select_unique(Sample_type, Patient, Condition, BioReplicate, TechReplicate, Sample, Accession, ProteinFirst,GeneFirst, OrganismFirst, 
           Peptide, Sequence, Length_range) 

seq_all_condition <-
  pep_all |> 
  select_unique(Sample_type, Patient, Condition, Accession, ProteinFirst,GeneFirst, OrganismFirst, 
           Peptide, Sequence, Length_range) 

seq_short_sample <- 
  pep_short |> 
  select_unique(Sample_type, Patient, Condition, BioReplicate, TechReplicate, Sample, Accession, ProteinFirst,GeneFirst, OrganismFirst, 
           Peptide, Sequence, Length_range) 

seq_short_condition <-
  pep_short |> 
  select_unique(Sample_type, Patient, Condition, Accession, ProteinFirst,GeneFirst, OrganismFirst, 
           Peptide, Sequence, Length_range) 


var_levels <-  c("Peptide", "Sequence", "Accession")
```


# summary counts for each peptide or protein per condition, patient, sample_type

- Filtered  = removed  accessions that were empty or had "Cont_" (contaminants)
- n_Samples.XXX = number of samples of a Patient or Patient_Sample_type where the peptide was found
- n_Patient.XXX = number of patients of Sample_type where the peptide was found
- in_Sample_type = logical, TRUE if found in Sample_Type




```{r pep-patient-summary}
pep_patient_biorep_summary <-
  pep_all  |> 
  mutate(Area_imputed = is.na(Log2Area)) |> 
  mutate(Log2Area = replace_na(Log2Area, 6.5)) |> 
   group_by(Sample_type, Patient, Condition, BioReplicate, Accession, ProteinFirst,GeneFirst, OrganismFirst, 
           Peptide, Sequence, Length_range) |> 
  summarise(n_Samples = n_distinct(Sample),
            Area_mean = mean(Area),
            Area_max = max(Area),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  ungroup() 



pep_patient_condition_summary <-
  pep_all  |> 
  mutate(Area_imputed = is.na(Log2Area)) |> 
  mutate(Log2Area = replace_na(Log2Area, 6.5)) |> 
  group_by(Sample_type, Patient, Condition, BioReplicate, Accession, ProteinFirst,GeneFirst, OrganismFirst, 
           Peptide, Sequence, Length_range) |> 
  summarise(n_Samples = n_distinct(Sample),
            Area_mean = mean(Area),
            Area_max = max(Area),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  ungroup() 
```


## Peptide-level

- Exported in 3_results/counts_pep_all_wide (all peptides)
- Exported in 3_results/counts_pep_selected_wide (`r paste0("Selected peptides (", shortpep_range[1]," to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)")`)


Note: protein groups are encoded in the "Accession".  "ProteinFirst" was not included in the table because some peptides were attributed to different ProteinFirst despite having the same Sequence and Accession (protein group). This was because files were processed in multiple processes.

# All peptides - overlap between Conditions, per Sample_type {.tabset}

```{r upset-all-by-sampletype, echo=FALSE,  fig.height=3.0, fig.width=3.5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
for(j in 1:length(sampletypes)){
  cat("\n## ", sampletypes[j],"{.tabset} \n")
  up_list_j <-
     seq_all_condition |> 
    filter_unique(Sample_type ==  sampletypes[j]) |> 
    plot_upset_batch(vars = var_levels, Compare = "Condition")
  for (i in 1:length(var_levels)) {
    cat("\n### ", var_levels[i],"\n")
    up_list_j[i]  |>  print()
    cat('\n\n')
  }
  cat('\n')
}
```
